integrity: All finite certificate comparisons are integer-exact; broader growth is analytical. No external independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact ladder coefficients are proved only for 2 through 6 columns. For arbitrary width only explicit linear upper and lower bounds are proved. Weighted and higher-row arrays are outside scope; historical originality is qualified by incomplete access to all older literature.
title: Linear variation instability and exact small-width constants for two-row isotonic regression
